title: Precise nanodelivery of screened compounds alleviates sepsis-associated encephalopathy by targeting microglial ANXA2.
authors: Lin, Daoyi; Huang, Yuan; Wu, Shuyan; Li, Zefu; Dai, Hanhao; Gao, Fei; Wang, Danfeng; Xu, Maokai; An, Ziqi; Li, Xinmu; Ye, Peng; Chen, Yingjie; Huang, Yongxin; Deng, Jianhui; Wang, Hongyi; Li, Zhe; Shi, Yue; Liu, Xiaowen; Li, Weixia; Fang, Xiaobin; Zhao, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脓毒症相关脑病的纳米药物递送与ANXA2靶点，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sepsis frequently induces sepsis-associated encephalopathy (SAE), which lacks targeted therapies and often results in persistent neurobehavioral deficits. Here, we developed a translational pipeline integrating target discovery, small-molecule screening, formulation engineering, targeted delivery, and in vivo mechanistic validation to establish a microglial neuroinflammation-centered SAE intervention. Integrative transcriptomic analysis of septic patient brain tissue (GSE135838), combined with weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), identified Annexin A2 (ANXA2) as a microglia-associated candidate linked to SAE. In cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) mice, Anxa2 was markedly upregulated in the hippocampus and enriched in microglia. Mechanistically, small interfering RNA (siRNA)-mediated Anxa2 silencing in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated BV2 and primary microglia inhibited nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) activation, reduced M1-like polarization and cytokine release, and alleviated neuronal apoptosis in co-culture. Screening of the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database (TCMSP) combined with high-throughput surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi) identified evodiamine as a high-affinity ANXA2 binder, further supported by molecular dynamics simulations, drug-likeness assessment, and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) profiling. To improve efficacy, enhance blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, and reduce potential cardiotoxicity, we engineered an Angiopep-2/phosphatidylserine dual-modified evodiamine-loaded liposome (L-A-P@E). In SAE mice, L-A-P@E improved anxiety-like behavior and cognition, attenuated hippocampal neuroinflammation and neuronal apoptosis, and suppressed microglial ANXA2/NF-kappaB signaling without detectable systemic immunogenicity. Knockdown-rescue assays using a triple-mutant Anxa2 construct and AAV-mediated hippocampal Anxa2 overexpression confirmed that evodiamine's therapeutic effects depended on the ANXA2-binding pocket and ANXA2/NF-kappaB signaling. These findings identify microglial ANXA2/NF-kappaB as a druggable SAE target and support targeted nanodelivery for mechanism-based therapy.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症常诱发脓毒症相关脑病（SAE），该病缺乏靶向治疗，常导致持续性神经行为缺陷。在此，我们开发了一条转化研究管线，整合靶点发现、小分子筛选、制剂工程、靶向递送及体内机制验证，以建立以微胶质细胞神经炎症为核心的SAE干预策略。对脓毒症患者脑组织（GSE135838）的整合转录组分析，结合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），将膜联蛋白A2（ANXA2）鉴定为与SAE相关的微胶质细胞候选靶点。在盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）小鼠中，Anxa2在海马区显著上调，并在微胶质细胞中富集。机制上，在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的BV2和原代微胶质细胞中，通过小干扰RNA（siRNA）介导的Anxa2沉默抑制了核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）激活，减少了M1样极化和细胞因子释放，并在共培养中减轻了神经元凋亡。结合中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）筛选与高通量表面等离子体共振成像（SPRi），鉴定出吴茱萸碱为高亲和力ANXA2结合剂，并进一步通过分子动力学模拟、类药性评估及吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）分析予以支持。为提高疗效、增强血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性并降低潜在心脏毒性，我们设计了Angiopep-2/磷脂酰丝氨酸双修饰的吴茱萸碱脂质体（L-A-P@E）。在SAE小鼠中，L-A-P@E改善了焦虑样行为和认知功能，减轻了海马神经炎症和神经元凋亡，并抑制了微胶质细胞ANXA2/NF-kappaB信号通路，且未检测到系统性免疫原性。使用三突变Anxa2构建体的敲低-回补实验及AAV介导的海马Anxa2过表达实验证实，吴茱萸碱的治疗效果依赖于ANXA2结合口袋及ANXA2/NF-kappaB信号通路。这些发现将微胶质细胞ANXA2/NF-kappaB确定为可药用的SAE靶点，并支持基于机制的靶向纳米递送疗法。
